title: Safety of rotigotine in patients with autosomal dominant polycystic kidney disease - ETERNAL-PKD
official: Safety of rotigotine in patients with autosomal dominant polycystic kidney disease - ETERNAL-PKD
summary: Main objective: To evaluate the safety of rotigotine administered at a dose of 4 mg/24 hours for 24 months in patients with ADPKD.
criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
1. - ADPKD patients aged 18 to 60 years
2. - Normotensive or hypertensive patients treated controlled (SBP/DBP on diurnal ABPM <135/85 mmHg and/or mean ABPM <130/80 mmHg less than 3 months old)
Exclusion criteria:
1. - Stage 4 or 5 renal insufficiency (GFR CKD-EPI<30 ml/min/1.73m2)
2. - Severe hepatic insufficiency (Child-Pugh class C)
3. - Patients currently being treated or treated in the 6 months preceding the trial with a dopamine agonist or antagonist (L-dopa, neuroleptics, metoclopramide)
4. - Systolic heart failure requiring hospitalization in the 6 months preceding inclusion or known heart failure with an LVEF <30%
5. - Orthostatic hypotension (decrease in SBP > 20 mm Hg and/or DBP > 10 mm Hg)
6. - Excessive alcohol consumption (greater than 20 g/day)
7. Known allergy to sulfites
8. - History of addictive behavior, particularly gambling, compulsive purchasing or hypersexuality
9. - Drug addiction or suspected illicit drug use
10. - Taking other sedative medications or other central nervous system depressants (benzodiazepines, antipsychotics, antidepressants) - Known allergy to sulphites
11. - Contraindication to NEUPRO
12. - Contraindication to MRI
13. - Renal transplant patients
14. - Dialysis patients
15. - History of myocardial infarction or stroke less than 6 months old
